name: year_end_prepaid_insurance_and_accrued_loan_interest
question_template: A company's fiscal year runs 1 January to 31 December (January is month 1). On the first day of month {START_MONTH} it pays {PREMIUM} USD in cash for an insurance policy covering exactly {POLICY_MONTHS} months from that date. Insurance expense is recognized evenly per month of coverage; any coverage not yet used at 31 December is carried as a prepaid asset. On the first day of month {LOAN_MONTH} it draws a loan of {PRINCIPAL} USD at {RATE} percent per year. Interest accrues on the full principal every month at one-twelfth of the annual rate and is paid in cash in arrears at the end of each {PAY_INTERVAL}-month period counted from the drawdown date; if a payment date falls on 31 December it is paid that day. Interest accrued but not yet paid at 31 December is an accrued liability. Compute the total expense recognized in the fiscal year for insurance plus loan interest, regardless of cash paid.

slots.description: Unexpired insurance premium carried as prepaid asset at 31 December
Interest accrued but unpaid at 31 December
Insurance expense recognized in the fiscal year

program:
def solve():
    premium = Q(P["PREMIUM"])
    pm = int(P["POLICY_MONTHS"])
    start = int(P["START_MONTH"])
    principal = Q(P["PRINCIPAL"])
    rate = Q(P["RATE"])
    lm = int(P["LOAN_MONTH"])
    interval = int(P["PAY_INTERVAL"])
    if pm <= 0 or interval <= 0:
        raise ValueError("policy length and payment interval must be positive")
    months_in_year = 13 - start
    months_covered = min(months_in_year, pm)
    insurance_expense = premium * Q(months_covered) / Q(pm)
    prepaid = premium - insurance_expense
    loan_months = 13 - lm
    monthly_interest = principal * rate / Q(1200)
    interest_expense = monthly_interest * Q(loan_months)
    unpaid_months = loan_months % interval
    accrued = monthly_interest * Q(unpaid_months)
    total_expense = insurance_expense + interest_expense
    return {
        "final": total_expense,
        "prepaid_insurance_asset": prepaid,
        "accrued_interest_liability": accrued,
        "insurance_expense": insurance_expense,
    }
